fit_reason: Private-owner listing for a whole 2005 Glastron GX205 bowrider on its trailer, a boat we can detail.
findings: Black hull band and gelcoat look glossy overall, with only a slightly muted shine on the dark side panels near the Glastron lettering
Cream gelcoat on the bow and deck looks clean with no obvious chalking
Light marks and dulling on the gray cockpit carpet around the helm and passenger seats
Vinyl seats and side bolsters look clean, with some minor dulling on the rear sun pad
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Glastron GX205. It looks well kept, and a light wax on the black hull band plus a clean of the cockpit carpet would make it pop even more in photos and at showings. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
